title: Jammer Configuration
description: Jamming attack simulation configuration. Supports barrage (wideband), constant (narrowband Gaussian noise), and random (burst/idle cycling) attack types.

attack_type.description: Type of jamming attack. barrage = wideband noise across full bandwidth, constant = narrowband Gaussian noise at a tone offset, random = burst/idle cycling of barrage

sampling_freq.description: Sampling frequency in Hz (must be >= 2x bandwidth for Nyquist)

num_samples.description: Number of waveform samples to generate (buffer size for streaming)

tone_offset_hz.description: Baseband frequency offset for constant/partial-band jamming in Hz. 0 = auto-shift to +1.92 MHz to avoid NR DC subcarrier. Typical values: +/-1.92e6, +/-3.84e6

burst_duration_ms.description: Burst duration in milliseconds for random attack type

idle_duration_ms.description: Idle duration in milliseconds for random attack type

jam_bandwidth_hz.description: Narrowband noise bandwidth in Hz for constant attack type (e.g., 1.92e6 for SSB-targeted jamming)

num_tones.description: Number of tones used to synthesize the noise comb for constant attack

write_iq.description: Write IQ samples to .fc32 binary file

enable_autoconfigure.description: Enable InfluxDB-based autoconfiguration of RF parameters
